name: Void Reaver
description:
About This Game

You're stranded on a crumbling alien planet with nothing but your weapon and an empty backpack. To survive this sci-fi bullet heaven, you’ll need to master the art of aggressive organization and nimble movements.

Climb a towering alien monolith while facing hordes of enemies, collect experimental tech and jigsaw your inventory into an unstoppable engine of destruction. The Void is waiting, and your inventory space is limited. 

Pack light. Shoot heavy.

YOUR INVENTORY IS YOUR WEAPON

Forget simple equipment slots. Here, placement is power.

  • Strategize: Arrange weapons and artifacts in your backpack grid to activate powerful adjacency bonuses.

  • Synergize: Place elemental weapons next to melee blades for hybrid damage, or link engineering items to drones for epic buffs.

  • Evolve: Merge duplicate items to increase their rarity and unlock devastating new properties.

SURVIVE THE ONSLAUGHT

The combat is fast, fluid, and brutal. Your weapons fire automatically, leaving you free to focus on what matters: Movement and Survival.

  • Dodge & Destroy: Weave through thousands of enemies while your optimized build unleashes chaos.

  • Elite Challenges: Face multi-phase bosses and elite enemies that will test your reflexes and your build's efficiency.

  • Dynamic Arenas: Adapt to biome-specific events in hand-tailored arenas designed for infinite replayability.

ASSEMBLE YOUR CREW & EVOLVE

Death is just the beginning. The roguelite progression ensures you come back stronger after every defeat.

  • Deep Meta-Progression: Use resources gathered in the tower to upgrade your ship’s tech tree and unlock permanent bonuses for all characters.

  • Unique Specialists: Choose from a growing roster of survivors - from melee berserkers to drone engineers and long range snipers. Each character features their own unique dash, active ability and skill tree containing playstyle defining passive abilities.

  • Limitless Combinations: With 100+ weapons, 200+ artifacts, and 10 unique characters, there are over 10 quintillion possible builds to discover.

FIGHT TO THE BEAT

Set your pace to a masterfully crafted and powerful soundtrack by acclaimed electronic music artist and studio co-creator Nibana, inspired by artists such as Solar Fields (Mirror's Edge / Mirror's Edge: Catalyst), featuring the reveal of his brand new music project Analog Anxiety and collaborations with Psychedelic Trance legends like Ajja, Ryanosaurus, Kliment and Lunarave.

The OST will be released as a fully streamable 12+ tracks album, unlockable within the game, and manageable from the Jukebox Menu where you will be able to playlist your favorite songs from a level to another and curate your own music experience.

KEY FEATURES

  • Tactical Inventory System: A puzzle within the battle. Rearrange items to trigger synergies, set bonuses, and merge duplicates for exponential power gains.

  • Fast-Paced Auto-Combat: A pure "Survivor-like" experience where your skill lies in positioning and dodging while your build handles the firepower.

  • Insane Build Variety: Experiment with Elemental, Engineering, Projectile or even Melee archetypes across a roster of distinct characters.

  • Persistent Progression: Unlock permanent upgrades and new items via a shared Ship Tech Tree and individual Character Skill Trees.

  • Epic Boss Fights: Face strong bosses with phase-based attack patterns and mechanics.

  • High-octane Jukebox: Fight to the beat of outstanding electronic music from internationally acclaimed musicians and curate your own playlist.

  • A human-sized indie experience: We have put sweat and tears in Void Reaver, our first game ever, to bring you a 100% hand-crafted game valuing human artists with a strict NO AI ART stance.

    We're still lacking in experience but we're looking to work alongside every gamers that give Void Reaver a chance to make a game we can be proud of and you can have good times on !
short_desc: Organize. Optimize. Obliterate. Void Reaver is a sci-fi bullet heaven where your backpack is your firepower. Grid-manage 300+ weapons and artifacts into explosive synergies, unlock specialized skill trees, and blast through alien hordes to a high-octane electronic soundtrack.
